lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
The federal Liberals are teeing up Thursday’s budget as the government’s next step toward fixing long-standing problems facing Canada’s economy, The Canadian Press reports.

British comedian and actor Russell Brand was convicted on Thursday of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault linked to allegations dating back more than 20 years, The Associated Press reports.

Some protesters clashed with police in Paris and Lyon on Thursday during largely peaceful nationwide demonstrations and a one-day strike by some public sector workers in a renewed challenge to President Emmanuel Macron, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
